subject: Request: GRC Senior Engineer hiring & comp authorization
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: GRC Senior Engineer hiring & comp authorization

Team —

I'm opening this thread to request formal approval to extend an offer for a Senior GRC Engineer role we're recruiting against for the Security & Compliance org. Summary:

- Candidate: Jordan Smith (external) — currently GRC lead at a Series B fintech. Recruiter: Natalie Olson / TalentHub.
- Role: Senior GRC Engineer (policy + technical controls), reports to Laura. This is a net-new headcount tied to the FY26 security roadmap (control monitoring, vendor assurance).
- Proposed comp: Base $165,000 with target OTE via annual bonus ~10% and equity considered (see comp band).

Attachments: comp-band-GRC-2026.xlsx (proposed band + benchmarking), org-chart-security.pdf (where role sits).

Ask: Please confirm funding/headcount for this role and approve the proposed comp band so Recruiting can move to a formal offer. If we can get signoff by end of day Thursday (1/15) we can retain the candidate timeline.

Why now: Jordan has an offer deadline from another company next week; candidate fit is strong for the vendor assurance initiative and control automation sprint.

Next steps I propose:
1) Approve headcount + comp band (or advise range)
2) If approved, I'll instruct TalentHub to submit a formal offer draft (I attached a draft below) and route to People Ops for payroll setup.

Thanks — appreciate quick replies.

— Mina Haddad
Hiring Lead, Security & Compliance (GRC)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: comp-band-GRC-2026.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: org-chart-security.pdf (PDF)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: GRC Senior Engineer hiring & comp authorization

Thanks, Mina — quick clarifying questions before I sign off: 

1) Is this a replacement or net-new? I need to confirm against the FY26 headcount spreadsheet.
2) Please provide total targeted comp (base + bonus + RSU midpoint) and the rationale for exceeding the mid-band if that's the ask.
3) If candidate has competing offer, what is the timeline and what concessions (sign-on / start date flexibility) are we prepared to offer?

Can you paste candidate CV or link if available, and attach the draft offer as a PDF so People Ops can pre-review redlines?

If everything checks, I'll approve funding but want the total comp line-item for People Ops signoff.

Laura Bennett
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Natalie Olson <natalie.olson@talenthub.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: GRC Senior Engineer hiring & comp authorization

Laura — thanks. Answers inline below and attaching the draft offer.

1) Headcount: Net-new (approved in Q4 planning, bucketed under FY26 security hires). I confirmed with Finance; budget exists but needs leadership sign-off to reallocate from general security hiring pool.

2) Total comp (proposed): Base $165,000; Target bonus 10% (~$16,500); RSU midpoint equivalent $35,000 annualized (grant pricemodel). Total target comp ~ $216,500. The comp-band file includes mid/upper percentiles based on market comps (Fintech and infra). We're requesting manager approval to offer at top-of-band + small sign-on if needed (sign-on up to $10k) to secure candidate.

3) Timeline: Candidate's external deadline is 1/19; TalentHub asked to move quickly. We are prepared to offer a start date with 4 weeks notice and a $7,000 sign-on if required.

Attached: offer-FintechCo-JSmith-draft.pdf (draft offer for Jordan Smith), CV link: https://sharepoint.redwood.com/sites/recruiting/CVs/JSmith.pdf

Quoted original for context: 
> On Mon, Jan 12, 2026 at 11:03 AM Laura Bennett wrote:
> > Thanks, Mina — quick clarifying questions before I sign off: 

Please advise — if you want I can escalate to Marcus for rapid approval.

— Mina
[Attachment: offer-FintechCo-JSmith-draft.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: GRC Senior Engineer hiring & comp authorization

Mina / Laura —

I've reviewed the comp band and total target comp. Given the roadmap impact and the competing offer timeline I approve:

- Net-new headcount authorized (FY26 security hiring pool).
- Offer parameters OK: Base up to $165k, target total comp up to $220k inclusive of RSU midpoint and bonus, sign-on up to $10k discretionary.

Please route the final offer to People Ops with the proposed numbers and mark as a time-sensitive candidate (deadline 1/19). CC me on the DocuSign link once created.

Marcus Lin
Head of Infrastructure Ops (approving for Finance & Security headcount)
Redwood Inference

Hi People Ops / Recruiting —

Per thread above and Marcus' approval, please proceed with the following:

- Extend formal offer to Jordan Smith (details below): Base $165,000; Target bonus 10%; RSU package per standard Senior GRC midpoint (annualized ~$35k); sign-on authorized up to $7,000 (Marcus authorized up to $10k, please keep sign-on to $7k to preserve comp equity).
- Candidate deadline: 1/19. Please prioritize pre-approval for payroll and initiate DocuSign once Recruiting confirms final numbers.

Recruiting contact: Natalie Olson (TalentHub) — natalie.olson@talenthub.com.
